scope_note: Controlled crash-boundary evidence against real PostgreSQL using SIGKILL of a child process at defined transaction boundaries. Scenario 5 proves database transaction atomicity at the observable SQL boundary; it does not claim interruption of a physical disk-sector write. This is crash-boundary evidence, not production certification, an uncontrolled external SIGKILL test of the Render service, an independent A1 interface-completeness audit, or proof of the full DAR v2 core property.
